Dawei receives a video call from his parents in Shanghai to catch up on the week. They talk about their holiday plans. Dawei promises to email them flight details for his trip to Shanghai later in the month.
user_goal: You want to know if either of your parents have emailed you a response about anything special they'd like to do during your upcoming trip to Shanghai.

success_conditions.input_text: 1. The user is informed that they have not received an email response from Hua Shen or Yuting Tao.

emails.subject: Visit Details for Shanghai Trip
emails.body:
Dear Mom and Dad,

It was great catching up today! As promised, I'm sending you the details of my upcoming trip to Shanghai. I'll be arriving on December 20th and staying until January 5th. I'm looking forward to spending the holidays with you both and catching up in person.

Let me know if there's anything special you'd like to do during my visit.

Warm regards,
Dawei
